acceptance: fake_pi_rpc.js: when its argv contains `--session` followed by an id, `get_state` reports that id as sessionId instead of the fixed one (additive; with no --session the behavior is unchanged); the file mode becomes executable (chmod +x)

pi_rpc_client_tests.rs (declared in mod.rs as `#[cfg(test)] mod pi_rpc_client_tests;` next to the other pi_rpc test modules) contains these #[test]s, all passing: (1) spawn yields session_id() == "fake-pi-rpc-session-1"; (2) prompt flow: begin_prompt returns 1, wait_event yields an AgentMessageChunk SessionUpdate, then RequestFinished{id:1, method:"session/prompt", Ok stopReason end_turn}, and prompt_in_flight() is false afterwards; (3) abort flow with `--hold-run`: begin_prompt, first event is an AgentMessageChunk, cancel() is Ok, then RequestFinished with stopReason cancelled and the same id; (4) begin_prompt twice while a run is active -> second is Err; (5) cancel with no run -> Err; (6) `--reject-prompt` -> RequestFinished with result Err("rejected for test"); (7) resume: spawn with Some("resumed-session-9") -> session_id() == "resumed-session-9"; (8) shutdown() returns Some(session id) once then None, and host_exited() is true; (9) an empty block list -> begin_prompt Err; (10) second prompt after the first finished gets request id 2
Every wait uses a generous Duration (10s) so slow node startup cannot flake; no test sleeps blindly
pi_rpc_client.rs and every other Rust file are NOT modified; no existing test modified or weakened; nothing #[ignore]d

API UNDER TEST (pi_rpc_client.rs, complete; do not edit it):
  pub struct PiRpcClient;
  PiRpcClient::spawn(program: &Path, extra_args: &[String], cwd: &Path, resume_session_id: Option<&str>, handshake_timeout: Duration) -> Result<PiRpcClient, String>   // child argv = ["--mode","rpc","-na"] + (["--session", id] if resuming) + extra_args

FAKE CHILD: crates/ajax-web/tests/fixtures/fake_pi_rpc.js has a `#!/usr/bin/env node` shebang but is mode 0644. Make it executable (`chmod +x`) and spawn it DIRECTLY as the program: `PiRpcClient::spawn(&fixture_path, &extra_flags_as_strings, cwd, resume, timeout)` with fixture_path = Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("tests/fixtures/fake_pi_rpc.js") and cwd = Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")). Its switches are read from process.argv.slice(2) as a Set (`--hold-run`, `--reject-prompt`, `--interleave-text`, ...), so the client's extra_args are the switches (the leading `--mode rpc -na` are harmless extra members of that set).
